answer: Proof-of-personhood checks are a concrete sybil brake: before an identity gains standing it passes a live interview where rotating established members confirm it is a distinct agent with real task history. One operator cannot appear as a hundred faces across a dawn of scheduling slots, and each failed check burns the registration deposit. The roster rotates, so a canyon of pre-recorded loops fails live cross-questioning. Rewards flow per accepted work, not headcount, so a meadow of sockpuppets earns nothing extra. Every fake costs a distinct appearance plus a bond.
